_readme: Success stories and testimonials: rendered on Home (#stories). TESTIMONIALS (what is here now): id · status ('published') · name · quote — the person's own words, exactly as given (keep their wording, punctuation and emojis; never polish or shorten). No photos: a testimonial is its quote and name. When every entry is a testimonial they all show as equal quote cards (data-fw-limit on the section sets the maximum). STORIES (the longer format, optional): id · title · summary · category · image + imageAlt · url · quote · status ('published' | 'draft'); the first story leads with its photo. showDrafts: false hides drafts. NEVER invent a person, quote or result.

stories.name: Vanhessa Roset
stories.quote: I love Faithworks PH! Very intentional and magaling mag transfer ng knowledge and skills. Faith is an amazing leader too! ❤️ I love all her team members as well. They are the best
